subject: Pilot: Refurbished Laptop Lifecycle + Cross-border Return Logistics
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: ops@depotlogistics.com, sales@returnly.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: Refurbished Laptop Lifecycle + Cross-border Return Logistics

Hi team,

We're planning a small pilot to validate a refurbished-device lifecycle for EMEA and select APAC markets. Goal: reduce procurement cost on mid-tier employee replacements, tighten return/repair SLAs, and test an internal resale/e-waste credit flow.

High level asks:
- Can DepotLogistics handle cross-border inbound returns (UK/IE/DE -> EU depot) with customs paperwork and a 5-business-day RMA SLA?
- Can Returnly supply certified refurbished units (i5/16GB/512GB) with 12-month warranty and refurbishment certificate?
- What are your lead times and pilot pricing for ~120 devices over 3 months?
- We need an end-to-end mutual action plan and an RACI for imaging, SIM handling, and loaner pool management.

Attached: RFI_refurb_specs.pdf (device acceptance criteria) and initial_mrp.xlsx (volume estimates & rough budget).

Timeline: we want procurement and logistics process defined by 2027-06-03 to kick off a June pilot.

Please reply with availability for a 30-min sync this week and any initial questions.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Workplace Ops, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

---
Attachment(s): RFI_refurb_specs.pdf (1.2 MB), initial_mrp.xlsx (42 KB)

From: DepotLogistics <ops@depotlogistics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:03:21 +0100
Subject: Re: Pilot: Refurbished Laptop Lifecycle + Cross-border Return Logistics

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks for the details — happy to run the pilot. Quick answers up front:
- Cross-border returns: yes. We operate depots in NL, DE, and SG (for APAC) and provide CN22/CYB paperwork + brokered customs clearance.
- RMA SLA: standard 5 business days to triage + 10 business days to repair/refurbish; expedited options available for loaner pool (2 business days) at a premium.
- Pilot pricing: see attached DL_Proposal_Q3.pdf — we included modular line items (pick-up, diagnostics, repair, customs handling, disposal). Estimated logistics + customs for 120 units: €7.2k over 3 months without expedited service.
- E-waste: partner with GreenCycle for certified disposal and an e-waste credit back to Redwood (projected €1.5k credit over pilot if minimum thresholds met).

Open questions:
1) Will Redwood require device imaging in our facility or should devices be pre-wiped and imaged by your IT team?
2) Loaner pool: do you need a dedicated permanent pool or a rotator managed by us?

Proposed next steps:
- 30-min kickoff this Thu 11:00 BST to confirm depot routing and customs rules for DE/IE/UK.
- Shared Drive with SOPs and EORI paperwork.

Regards,
Ben Lowe
Operations Lead, DepotLogistics
ops@depotlogistics.com

---
Attachment(s): DL_Proposal_Q3.pdf (776 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: ops@depotlogistics.com, irene@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: Refurbished Laptop Lifecycle + Cross-border Return Logistics

Thanks Ben — a couple clarifications from IT side: 

1) Imaging: we prefer imaging in our secure environment (to keep KMS keys and proprietary images in-house), but we need DepotLogistics to perform secure wiping, diagnostics, and couriering back to our imaging center. We'll provide a signed chain-of-custody manifest per batch.
2) SIMs: some APAC devices have embedded SIMs and we need an option to quarantine devices while we swap eSIM profiles. Please include a separate SKU for SIM-handling in the proposal.
3) Loaner pool: temporary rotator managed by DepotLogistics would be easiest for the pilot — please include a daily rental rate and damage waiver options.

Attaching a short imaging_playbook.md excerpt that lists our baseline checks and manifest format.

Karthik
Director, IT Platforms
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Appreciate the invite — we can supply certified refurbished units that match your spec (i5/16GB/512). Highlights:
- Unit price (pilot qty 120): $420 per machine (includes refurbishment, OS re-image, and 12-month warranty).
- Warranty: 12 months hardware + battery retention policy (we replace batteries that degrade below 80% health within 6 months).
- Refurb certificate: included per device (serial number and checklist).
- Turnaround: 7–12 business days for build-to-order; 3–5 days for stock SKUs.

Attached RH_SKU_list.csv with SKU breakouts and warranty terms. We're able to offer a 10% pilot discount and accept Net30 terms for enterprise customers.

Q: Are you open to a buyback/credit for returned devices that meet resale condition? We can run a simple grading and provide an upfront estimate.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
